title: Oops!.. I Did It Again! — JANUS semantic mechanics projection
purpose: Translate the preserved bilingual witness into reusable JANUS mechanics: actors, states, operators, state transitions, feedback loops, macro-machines, failure modes and translation-induced semantic drift. This layer does not replace the source witness and does not claim authorial intent.

state_variables.A_intent_commitment: Narrator's declared/actual seriousness toward the relationship.
state_variables.B_belief_commitment: Recipient's inferred belief that the relationship is more serious.
state_variables.A_self_model: Narrator's model of own recurring behavior and agency.
state_variables.B_idealization_of_A: Degree to which the recipient treats A as exceptional/transcendent.
state_variables.A_hero_projection: Degree to which A seeks or imagines ideal heroic figures.
state_variables.emotional_stake: Amount of attachment exposed to loss or disappointment.
state_variables.game_frame_strength: Degree to which relational interaction is represented as a game.
state_variables.loop_count: Number of perceived repetitions of the same relational pattern.
state_variables.mythic_symbol_value: Narrative value carried by the recovered/gifted object.

operator_catalog.name: REPEAT_PATTERN
operator_catalog.mechanic: A behavior is recognized as occurring again rather than as a one-off event.

operator_catalog.name: INDUCE_BELIEF
operator_catalog.mechanic: Signals from A cause B to infer a relationship state stronger than ordinary friendship.

operator_catalog.name: DOWNGRADE_COMMITMENT
operator_catalog.mechanic: A distinguishes apparent attraction from actual seriousness, lowering declared commitment.

operator_catalog.name: MISALIGN_INTERNAL_MODELS
operator_catalog.mechanic: B's inferred relationship model exceeds A's declared relationship model.

operator_catalog.name: GAMIFY_RELATIONSHIP
operator_catalog.mechanic: Emotional interaction is mapped onto a game with stakes, play, loss and repeated rounds.

operator_catalog.name: HEART_AS_STAKE
operator_catalog.mechanic: Attachment/heart becomes the vulnerable resource placed inside the game frame.

operator_catalog.name: TRANSCENDENT_ATTRIBUTION
operator_catalog.mechanic: B attributes exceptional or quasi-destined status to A.

operator_catalog.name: ASSERT_AGENCY_OVER_INNOCENCE
operator_catalog.mechanic: A rejects the model that her behavior is purely innocent or unaware.

operator_catalog.name: HERO_PROJECTION
operator_catalog.mechanic: A maintains an internal model in which heroic figures are desired to exist in reality.

operator_catalog.name: FANTASY_REALITY_TENSION
operator_catalog.mechanic: Persistent idealization coexists with elapsed time and emotional distress.

operator_catalog.name: SELF_MODEL_NORMALIZATION
operator_catalog.mechanic: Recurring behavior is folded into a stable self-description and treated as characteristic of A.

operator_catalog.name: REPETITION_REINFORCEMENT
operator_catalog.mechanic: Structural repetition replays the same state-transition bundle, strengthening it as the semantic attractor.

operator_catalog.name: DEPARTURE_THRESHOLD
operator_catalog.mechanic: The spoken bridge introduces an imminent departure, creating a narrow window for a final transfer/gift action.

operator_catalog.name: SYMBOL_RECOGNITION
operator_catalog.mechanic: The recipient recognizes the gift as an object with an already-known narrative history.

operator_catalog.name: IMPOSSIBLE_RECOVERY_BRIDGE
operator_catalog.mechanic: A previously lost narrative object is declared recovered, overriding the expected terminal state of the prior story.

operator_catalog.name: MYTHIC_GIFT_AMPLIFICATION
operator_catalog.mechanic: The gift's value is increased by the difficulty and narrative impossibility of its claimed recovery.

macro_machines.name: COUPLED_IDEALIZATION_ENGINE
macro_machines.interpretation: Two projections coexist: A idealizes an abstract hero, while B idealizes A. The text does not establish that either projection is accurate.

cases.mechanic: A broad attraction label is rendered as a stronger infatuation state.
Source-side self-judgment is reframed toward being interested/carried away by many things.
The source-side game-loss wording is rendered with the recipient as the loser.
A moral/culpability innocence axis is rendered closer to an epistemic naivety axis.

failure_modes.description: Treating A's intent and B's belief as the same state erases the central mismatch mechanic.
Treating this mechanics projection as a diagnosis or factual judgment about a real person exceeds the evidence.
Combining EN and UK lines as if mechanically identical hides agency and intensity drift.
Treating the spoken mythic-object bridge as literal real-world provenance instead of an intertextual narrative device breaks the model.

janus_machine_summary.compact_chain: SIGNAL -> BELIEF_UP -> COMMITMENT_GAP -> GAME_FRAME -> HEART_STAKE -> RECOGNIZE_REPEAT -> SELF_MODEL -> REPEAT
janus_machine_summary.meta_chain: TEXT -> ALIGNMENT -> MECHANICS -> DRIFT_CHECK -> MACHINE -> VERIFY

next_gate: JANUS_CULTURAL_MECHANICS_R2: test these operator chains against unrelated songs, films, dialogues or other texts and keep only mechanics that survive vocabulary changes without relying on song-specific nouns.
